==Format==
* '''Qualifiers''' - ''August 26th - September 10th, 2017''
** Five Regional Finals
*** The winner of the Korea Regional Final will advance to the Group Stage.
*** The winners of the China, Europe, TW/HK/MO, and North America Regional Finals will advance to the Play-In Stage.
* '''Play-In Stage 1''' - ''September 23rd - September 26th, 2017 in {{Flag|cn}} Wuhan''
** Twelve teams are divided into four groups where they play a Double Round Robin format.
*** All Matches are played in a {{Abbr/Bo1}}.
*** The top two teams in each group advance to Play-in Stage 2.
*** The remaining teams are eliminated.
* '''Play-In Stage 2''' - ''September 28th - September 29th, 2017 in {{Flag|cn}} Wuhan''
** Eight teams from Play-In Stage 1 are randomly paired for a {{Abbr/Bo5}}.
*** The winner of each match advances to the Group Stage.
*** The loser of each match is eliminated.
* '''Group Stage''' - ''October 5th - October 15th, 2017 in {{Flag|cn}} Wuhan''
** Four teams from Play-In Stage 2 join twelve teams with direct entry from Korea, China, Europe, TW/HK/MO, North America, and Southeast Asia.
** All sixteen teams are divided into four groups where they play a Double Round Robin format.
*** All Matches are played in a {{Abbr/Bo1}}.
*** The {{Bgcolortext|up|top two teams}} in each group advance to the Knockout Stage.
*** The {{Bgcolortext|down|remaining teams}} are eliminated.
* '''Knockout Stage''' - ''October 19th - November 4th, 2017 in {{Flag|cn}} Guangzhou, {{Flag|cn}} Shanghai, and {{Flag|cn}} Beijing''
** Eight teams play-in a single elimination bracket over seven days.
*** All matches are {{Abbr/Bo5}}.

==Prize Pool==
The initial prize pool of the tournament was $2,250,000 {{abbr/USD}}.<br />
An additional 25% of all Championship Ashe & Championship Ward skins are added to the total prize pool. <br />
The total prize pool is $4,946,970 {{Abbr/USD}} ($2,696,970 {{abbr/USD}} added).<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.lolesports.com/en_US/articles/update-fan-contribution-worlds-2017-prize-pool-0 |title=Update: Fan Contribution to Worlds 2017 Prize Pool |author=[[Riot Games]]|date=2017-11-03 |accessdate=2017-11-03}}</ref>
